description: After the business's inquiry form is sent with the haggl.ai code in its message, and only with the user's approval to share their email: records the claim for the cashback. haggl.ai uses the email only to send the reward.

code.description: The code haggl_inquiry_cashback gave, as put in the inquiry form.

email.description: The email the reward goes to, shared with the user's approval.

name: haggl_claim_inquiry_cashback

code.description: The code claimed; when the call failed, a machine-readable error code instead.

error.description: Present only when the call failed: what went wrong.

message.description: What happens next: tell the user.

recovery.description: When the outcome is uncertain: the tool and session_id to read before retrying.

retry_after_seconds.description: When rate limited: seconds to wait before retrying.

retryable.description: Whether the same call may be retried.
